chunks: So when you are free, work diligently.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran instruct believers to do when they are free from obligations?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a directive for continuous spiritual productivity, urging the believer to transition from obligatory acts (faraagh) to voluntary devotion (nasab) without idle pause. It highlights the concept of 'fana' (annihilation in worship) where one's entire being is dedicated to divine service, reflecting the Prophetic tradition of balancing worldly duties with relentless spiritual striving.
